versions.content: If the return ed value is DEM_NUMBER_PENDING, the J193 9 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction. The unused bytes 6 to 8 shall be set to 0xFF.

If the return ed value is DEM_NUMBER_PENDING, the J193 9 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction. The unused bytes 6 to 8 shall be set to 0xFF.

If the return ed value is DEM_NUMBER_PENDING, the J193 9 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction. The unused bytes 6 to 8 shall be set to 0xFF.
